description: This file defines a React component called ControlDevicesTab that manages the display and editing of control device mappings associated with an asset. It includes functionality for listing, creating, editing, and validation of control device mappings, integrating with an API, and handling user authentication and authorization.

methods.name: buildDeviceIndex
methods.description: Constructs a map from device ID to device object for quick lookup.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the list of control device mappings from API.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new control device mapping and opens the modal.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing an existing control device mapping.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the new or updated control device mapping, including validation, API calls, and user feedback.
